description: One EVM block by number, tag (latest, safe, finalized, earliest, pending) or hash on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Polygon or BNB Chain: timestamp and age, transaction count, gas used/limit and fill %, base fee (gwei), blob gas, fee recipient, size, withdrawals, parent hash, optional transaction hash list. Keyless public RPC, read-only. Price: $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/evm-block

block.description: Block number (decimal or 0x hex), a tag (latest, safe, finalized, earliest, pending) or a 32-byte block hash

chain.description: eth (default), base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon or bsc (chain ids and common aliases accepted)

name: evm_block
title: Evm Block
